scientific_integrity: The all-order theorem follows from a proved inclusion-exclusion recurrence; independent brute-force checks are finite corroboration, not an independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty unordered rooted trees only; one reflexive-descendant accessibility relation. The operation bound counts integer arithmetic rather than bit operations and is exponential in target maximum branching. No claim about general directed acyclic graphs, infinite frames, or priority over unseen specialized literature.
title: Exact bounded-morphism counting between arbitrary finite rooted tree frames
